correctness.rationale: Every nonempty independent set lies in a unique part. Vertices of that part outside the set have zero neighbors in it, while every vertex in every other part has exactly the set size as its number of neighbors in it. Thus odd independence is equivalent to odd cardinality, yielding the full enumerator and maximum formula. Exhaustive direct-definition checks through order 11 agree in all 183 multipartite types.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a complete all-set classification and closed enumerator for a broad classical family, and it exactly resolves the initiating paper’s alpha_od=alpha equality question within that family. It covers irregular complete bipartite graphs beyond the closest exact prior proposition, so it is more than a routine restatement of an already-known special case.
